purpose: What to CALL each hook on the diagram. The inventory names the SCRIPT that runs, and a script name is a file, not a name: the operator asked to see Caveman, RTK and BetterLeaks, not caveman-activate.js, rtk-active and betterleaks-hook.py. Data rather than code (R6), so a hook added to settings.json gets a name here without touching a module, and a name missing from this table degrades to a readable form of its own file name rather than to nothing (R11).
provenance: written 2026-09-01 from the hooks this machine declares in ~/.claude/settings.json, as listed by session-hooks-inventory.py
